We also keep cosmetics, parlour items, hair accessories, clips, earrings, finger rings, mangalsutra, necklace sets, bridal chokers, kids items and bangles in daily, casual, fancy & functional designs. Rental starts from ₹100 with many varieties. Visit our store near Dahisar Metro & Shakti Nagar for latest collections, great deals and friendly service. Walk-ins welcome!
